<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="pinkOrange" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
      <feOffset dy="1"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="linear" slope=".14"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="21" y="19" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="14" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="12" x2="331" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="10" x2="336" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="15" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="15" x2="352" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="382" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,60 21,69 30,78" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="46" y="74" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Back</text>
    <text x="195" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">PROFILE SETUP</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="128" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">When's your</text>
    <text x="30" y="166" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="32" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">birthday?</text>
    <text x="30" y="194" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Your date of birth helps us show you better matches.</text>

    <text x="30" y="231" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">DATE OF BIRTH</text>

    <g>
      <text x="31" y="264" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">MM</text>
      <line x1="30" y1="277" x2="104" y2="277" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="128" y="264" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">DD</text>
      <line x1="126" y1="277" x2="200" y2="277" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="224" y="264" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">YYYY</text>
      <line x1="222" y1="277" x2="360" y2="277" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>

    <text x="30" y="306" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You must be 18 or older to use Tinder.</text>

    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="90" y="337" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#pinkOrange)"/>
      <text x="195" y="365" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="420" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">This information will be kept private.</text>
    <line x1="30" y1="448" x2="360" y2="448" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="480" r="13" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="476" r="4" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="51" cy="486" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="75" y="484" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">You can change this later in Settings.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Numeric keypad -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="544" width="390" height="300" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="0" y="544" width="390" height="1" fill="#939393"/>

    <!-- Row 1 -->
    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="8" y="552" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="552" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="552" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    </g>
    <text x="67" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">1</text>
    <text x="195" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">2</text>
    <text x="323" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">3</text>

    <!-- Row 2 -->
    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="8" y="612" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="612" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="612" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    </g>
    <text x="67" y="645" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">4</text>
    <text x="195" y="645" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">5</text>
    <text x="323" y="645" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">6</text>

    <!-- Row 3 -->
    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="8" y="672" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="672" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="672" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    </g>
    <text x="67" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">7</text>
    <text x="195" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">8</text>
    <text x="323" y="705" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">9</text>

    <!-- Row 4 -->
    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="8" y="732" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="732" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="732" width="118" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    </g>
    <text x="67" y="765" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">0</text>
    <circle cx="195" cy="758" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="314" y1="756" x2="331" y2="756" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="314,756 320,750 320,762" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Keyboard navigation area / home indicator -->
    <rect x="0" y="790" width="390" height="54" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="817" x2="53" y2="817" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="195,806 203,814 195,822 187,814" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="814" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="145" y="831" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
